correctness.rationale: For w_i=1 at exactly i=2^j (j>=0) and w_0=0, k(n) counts marked positions and h=ceil(k/2). Distinct powers cannot form a 3-term progression or collide as two-pair sums; each palindromic factor contains <=2 ones, establishing the lower bound. Checked the reflected two-marker construction E_-1=0,E_j=3*4^j+1-E_{j-1}, two-case all-prefix factor split, and forced all-zero final palindrome at 2^r-1 (including r=2). Thus h<=P(n)<=h+1 all n>=0, P(E_j)=j+1, P(2^r-1)=ceil(r/2)+1, and P(n)=0.5log2(n)+O(1). Independent direct palindrome DP for all 700 prefixes reproduced both boundaries and examples. This finite DP corroborates, but the infinite proof is the reflection/counting argument.
